verdict.rationale: Airweave is an agent context and retrieval layer that syncs data into searchable collections and navigates entity hierarchies, so letting users customize the schema is a fair question for it. However, no evidence documents user-defined entity types, edge types, or an ontology. Building a custom source connector (docs-16) adds a data source; it does not customize the memory schema, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can customize the memory schema — entity types, edge types, or ontology — to match my domain
